prompts.ground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production GAME GROUND TEXTURE PAINTING ONLY, landscape 4:3, exactly 1024 by 768 pixels if possible. Input image is a STYLE AND GROUND-MATERIAL REFERENCE, do not copy its UI, characters, building or trees. Match the supplied game screenshot closely: restrained Graveyard Keeper-like handcrafted textured 2D pixel art, orthographic top-down three-quarter RPG view, tiny precise pixel clusters, weathered natural materials, moss green and desaturated olive grass, ochre brown earth, grey brown stone, upper-left light, restrained contrast. No bright toy-like shapes, glossy 3D, vector art, thick cartoon outlines, text, UI or watermark.
Create a continuous unbroken terrain canvas with very finely textured muted moss/olive grass, dry straw flecks, earth showing through naturally and subtly mottled soil. It must look as close as possible to the ground in the reference, without any square tile boundaries, grid, geometric checkerboard patches or repeating texture stamps. Entire canvas filled with terrain, viewed straight down with no perspective horizon. No trees, buildings, rocks, furniture, fences, shadows from unseen objects, graves, characters, bushes or water: these are independent game sprites.
Layout is in coordinates relative to a 1024x768 canvas: a wide organic worn ochre dirt road enters at left (0,560), meanders through (290,550), (470,530), (700,555), and exits at (1024,545). A softer branch curves down from (470,530) to bottom center (512,768). A narrow left garden footpath branches at (260,550), passes (270,350), reaches (240,190), then curves to a small resting clearing (365,225). A second smaller dirt footpath branches around (410,530), curves to (450,390), (570,390), and (700,370). A weathered irregular stone apron with scattered small cobbles lies at upper right x690..930,y270..350, approached by a curved patchy stone/dirt trail down to (845,565). Every path edge feathers into grass with organic eroded irregular borders and missing tufts, not straight grid steps. Leave center-left and mid-right grassy, with muted earth and yellowed dry grasses. Keep bottom-center dirt open for player spawn. This is reusable terrain art, not a screenshot, and contains no scene objects.
